mapper.select: select cu.user_id as user_id ,cu.user_name as user_name ,decrypt_f(cu.email_address) as email_address ,decrypt_f(cu.mobile_number) as mobile_number ,'' as company_code ,'' as company_name ,'' as business_place_code ,'' as business_place_name ,'' as dept_code ,'' as dept_name ,'' as job_code ,'' as job_name ,'' as position_code ,'' as position_name from com_user cu where 1=1 and cu.user_id = #{USER_ID}
